title: Focus the lesson report description on opening
steps: Open the lesson options drawer and click Report an Issue to inspect the blank description, placeholder, and character counter.
Type “The image is missing.” on the keyboard before clicking anywhere in the dialog and inspect the description and counter.
After the initial typing, use Tab to inspect the other available dialog controls without submitting or clearing the report.

video_guide.summary: Initial typing fills the lesson report description, followed by visible focus changes among dialog controls.

chapters.note: The open drawer includes Report an Issue.
The empty description has a teal focus outline and a 0/2500 counter.
Icon-name text overlaps several issue-category labels, including spellcheck and broken_image.

chapters.label: Type The image is missing. without clicking inside the dialog.

chapters.note: The description contains The image is missing. and the counter reads 21/2500.

chapters.label: Use Tab to move through the other dialog controls.

chapters.note: The lower form is visible, with a black outline around the yellow screenshot upload-instructions panel.
The checked technical-log checkbox has a black focus outline.
Cancel has dark focus styling while the report dialog remains open.
The Typo category has a black focus outline; the description contains the entered text and its counter reads 21/2500.
The description has a teal focus outline and a visible caret after The image is missing.; the counter reads 21/2500.
